mapper.select: WITH actor_allowed AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM t_user actor JOIN t_user_role user_role ON user_role.user_id = actor.id JOIN t_role_permission role_permission ON role_permission.role_id = user_role.role_id JOIN t_permission permission ON permission.id = role_permission.permission_id WHERE actor.id = #{actorUserId} AND actor.status = 1 AND actor.deleted_at IS NULL AND permission.code = 'security:manage' ) AS allowed ), target AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT status FROM t_user WHERE id = #{targetUserId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (SELECT allowed FROM actor_allowed) FOR UPDATE ), changed AS ( UPDATE t_user SET status = CASE WHEN #{suspended} THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{targetUserId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (SELECT allowed FROM actor_allowed) AND ( (#{suspended} AND status = 1) OR (NOT #{suspended} AND status = 2) ) RETURNING id ) SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (SELECT allowed FROM actor_allowed) THEN 0 WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 1 WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changed) THEN 4 WHEN (SELECT status FROM target) = 0 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_link_security_restriction (id, user_id, mode, active, reason_code, source) SELECT uuidv7(), #{targetUserId}, 'ALL', TRUE, 'ACCOUNT_SECURITY_SUSPENDED', 'ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION' FROM t_user WHERE id = #{targetUserId} AND status = 2 AND deleted_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user_link_security_restriction SET active = FALSE, revoked_at = now() WHERE user_id = #{targetUserId} AND source = 'ACCOUNT_SUSPENSION' AND active
